description: ### **ABOUT NUMA** Hey there! We're Numa, a forward-thinking hospitality brand redefining how people discover cities. We create spaces where simplicity meets innovation, offering thoughtfully designed rooms, studios, and apartments in the heart of Europe's most vibrant neighbourhoods. We're not just transforming the guest experience—we're revolutionizing the hospitality industry from the inside out. Our cutting-edge technology streamlines operations, delivering unparalleled value with no hidden fees—just real, quality experiences. At Numa, we believe that travel should be curious and authentic, and we bring those same values to our work culture. As part of our team, you'll experience a dynamic and supportive environment where creativity thrives, and your contributions make a real impact. We're committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace where every voice is valued, and different perspectives fuel our innovation. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Numa runs digitally managed apartments and hotels across Europe. Our Guest Experience team looks after guests before, during and after their stay, by phone, WhatsApp, email and booking-platform messaging, from several locations and together with external partner teams. Much of what the team uses day to day is built and run in-house, from planning and staffing to service quality and the knowledge that both people and AI assistants rely on. We are now setting up a dedicated team to own these tools as products, and you will be one of its first members. You will configure, connect, automate and build the tools the team uses every day, and keep them running. You are not expected to be a full-stack engineer. You are expected to be the person who makes our systems work better, using configuration, integrations, scripts and AI-assisted development, and who knows when to bring in our product and engineering teams. Your time splits across three kinds of work. The percentages are a guide, not a timesheet. **Build (about 60%): ship improvements from the roadmap** * Configure our business applications: routing, tagging, queues, rules, templates, roles and permissions in tools such as Front, Aircall, Dialpad, Notion and Slack. * Connect systems with APIs and webhooks, and automate manual work with n8n, scripts (Python, JavaScript, Apps Script) and BigQuery. * Build lightweight internal tools and prototypes with AI-assisted development (for example Claude, Claude skills and agents) where standard software does not fit. * Take a problem statement from idea to rollout: requirements, prototype, pilot, release, user training. * Write clear requirements for our product and engineering team on the AI guest assistants and agent copilot, and test their releases before they reach agents and guests. **Run (about 25%): keep what we built live and correct** * Own a small set of products: documented, monitored, with a backup person. * Watch workflows, integrations and alerts, and fix what breaks. * Handle bug reports from users within agreed response and fix times. * Manage user access, onboarding and offboarding across our tools together with IT. * Keep the documentation of every automation and tool current. **Support (about 15%): help users and listen to them** * Be the first point of contact for application questions from agents, team leads and partner teams. * Run the weekly idea triage, so every idea gets an answer within a week. * Publish release notes and give short demos every two weeks. * Check adoption four weeks after each release, and propose retiring what nobody uses. **How we work** * **What we build stays owned.** Every tool has an owner for its whole life, not just until it ships. * **Used, not just shipped.** Success means people use what we build and it improves a result that matters. * **Problem first.** Work starts from a clear problem and someone in the business who needs it solved. * **Built to last.** Documented, monitored and with a backup person, so nothing depends on one person

description: ### **About the role** Base is a comprehensive operating system for e-commerce that enables businesses to manage all of their online sales processes in one place, from product listing and order handling, through warehouse and shipping management, to repricing and expansion into international markets. Base serves more than 35,000 customers worldwide, processing over 320 million orders and more than $17 billion in GMV annually. The company already operates in 16 countries, including the USA, Germany, the United Kingdom, France, India, and Brazil, building local teams in each of them. We are one of the fastest-growing companies in the industry. We focus on culture, collaboration, and innovation that translate into real impact on how businesses operate. We are strengthening our Corporate Development function and are looking for an **M&A Manager** to lead the evaluation and execution of acquisitions and strategic investments. You will work closely with our Head of Corporate Development as their right hand, focusing on opportunities globally — from companies that complement Base's offering to new markets, technologies and capabilities. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for an experienced deal professional looking to move in-house, take ownership beyond the transaction itself, and help shape and build our Corporate Development function. ### **Key responsibilities** * **Deal execution:** Own the analysis, execution and project management of M&A transactions and strategic investments. * **Market and target analysis:** Map target markets, analyse competitors and potential acquisition targets, and build business cases for entering new markets. * **Financial analysis and valuation:** Build financial models, benchmark trading and transaction multiples, and prepare investment cases. * **Due diligence:** Coordinate due diligence streams, translating findings into clear recommendations. * **Structuring and negotiation:** Support transaction structuring and negotiations, including term sheets, LOIs, SPAs, earn-outs and management incentive arrangements. * **Deal project management:** Drive transaction projects, as well as post-acquisition integration. ### **What we are looking for** * 3–5 years of experience in private equity, investment banking or M&A advisory. * Hands-on experience working on M&A transactions, across all stages of the deal process. * Strong financial modelling and valuation skills. * Experience coordinating due diligence processes. * Strong analytical and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams in parallel. * Experience in technology, software, e-commerce or marketplace businesses is a plus. * Excellent written communication skills, **Pace and pragmatism:** You're comfortable with the speed and ambiguity that come with a fast-growing tech company. * **Hands-on approach:** You're happy to roll up your sleeves, moving easily between detailed analysis and big-picture strategy. * **Builder mindset:** You want to help shape a brand-new function, not just slot into an existing one. ### **What we offer** * A global role at the heart of strategy in a fast-growing technology company. * Direct work with the Head of Corporate Development, the Management Board and the shareholders. * Real ownership of transactions and the opportunity to shape how Corporate Development operates as the function scales.
